what_happened: Live-reproduced the Group 28/29 failures against the real (unstubbed) orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh and diffed the two actual composed dispatch files to isolate the exact byte-level cause: the Issue Log block's [--dispatch-seq N] placeholder (added by commit 21f282089, 2026-10-03) is not stripped by cycle_plan_dispatch_hash()'s normalizer, so identical dispatches never hash equal. git log -S pinpointed the single introducing commit.

Research proved the root cause mechanically (diffed the two dispatch files the SUT itself wrote, then hashed both with and without a corrected strip pattern) rather than inferring it from code reading, and dated the regressing commit by content-anchored git log -S. Planning needed only verification of the named line numbers, not independent re-diagnosis, so the plan collapsed to a one-line fix wrapped in a red-first fixture.

Full run-all.sh --fail-on-new sweep surfaced an UNRELATED NEW failure in test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh ('baseline fixture is not clean (rc=1, gate20 finding lines=0)'), outside this task's file_scope and acceptance criteria (which names only test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh). Not fixed here; flagged for a separate owner.

verify-deploy.sh gate 13 (whole-tree orphan detection) reports 3 pre-existing findings (scripts/roadmap-integration.sh, scripts/tests/test-roadmap-argv-ceiling.sh, scripts/tests/test-roadmap-items-producer.sh) -- additive-only deployed files whose source was quarantined to agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/deprecated/ by an unrelated, already-committed prior change. Verified unrelated to this task: this task's own 4 edited files (orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh, tests/test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, tests/known-failures.txt) all diff byte-identical between source and deployed .claude/ counterpart. Per context/patterns/deploy-orphan-detection.md, deletion of these stale orphans is 'a deliberate human (or explicitly-scoped task) action' -- out of this task's file_scope, not attempted here. verify-deploy.sh otherwise reports 33/34 checks passing.

Task 351's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
